text:
alex: Heads-up — planning a joint performance benchmark with Nimbus for the cloud marketplace listing next quarter. Primary goals: perf/W (tokens/joule), steady-state throughput, and 99th latency at recommended batch sizes. Need a runbook and co-announcement timeline.

emily: +1. Are we tying this directly to a marketplace image release and PR? we need embargo dates and QA signoff. :thumbsup:

alex: Yes — marketplace AMI + co-marketing PR. Tentative PR target 2026-05-10 (will confirm once bench results land).

raj: Can we include partner-tuned kernel modules in the image? curious about distro/kernel compatibility risks.

nimbus-biz: We can provide tuned CUDA/cuDNN builds and a prebuilt AMI. License team flags: we can't bundle proprietary kernel blobs without approval; we can host them on our download portal and document installation steps.

samira: Draft test matrix below — ops/bench needs to validate power measurement setup. I'll own the runbook.

samira: ```
models: gpt2-xl, llama-2-13b, redwood-serve-mini
seq_lens: 128, 512
batches: 1, 4, 8
env: p4d.24xlarge (aws), a100-80g private rack
metrics: throughput_tok/s, tokens/joule (perf/W), p99_latency_ms, error_rate
configs: fp16 baseline, int8 quant (if available), with/without KV cache
telemetry: power_meter_id, rack_id, kernel_version, container_image_tag
```

kevin: For perf/W we need calibrated PDUs and stable wall power readings. @tim can you provision two PDUs with metering on the partner rack?

tim: Yep — provisioning PDU meters on rack-12 and rack-14. ETA 48h. Will post access creds.

alex: Also need legal + marketplace policy checks on third-party binaries. @sarah can you loop legal and marketplace product?

sarah: Looping legal + marketplace. Note: marketplace policy disallows executables that auto-update from external repos; partner downloads are OK if documented. Also need logo guidelines for co-announce.

bench-bot: scheduled_bench_run created: run_id=rb-2026-05-06-01, start_ts=1893600800 — results will be posted to #partnerships/results and linked in the runbook.

emily: Can we add an A/B test for KV cache enabled vs disabled and for kernel tune vs vanilla? those comparisons are great for co-marketing claims.

alex: Good call — add A/B for (KV cache on/off) and (partner-kernel vs distro-kernel).

nimbus-biz: We'll prepare a short release note and logos. Deadline for marketing assets: 1893607000. Also can share kernel diffs under NDA.

samira: I'll draft the runbook and post a PR to the repo by Friday. Will include instructions for telemetry tags, PDU wiring, and the exact bench commands.

alex: Sample bench command (will refine in runbook):

alex: ```bash
redwood-bench --model llama-2-13b \\n  --seq 512 --batch 4 \\n  --tokenize-benchmark \\n  --telemetry-tag "marketplace_nimbus_2026q2" \\n  --power-sensor /dev/ttyPDU0
```

kevin: Make sure bench script emits power readings aligned to token timestamps (1Hz min). ops prefers CSV upload to S3.

tim: will provide S3 bucket + presigned post.

sarah: I'll get legal approval flow started. Also we should pre-clear claim language: "up to X tokens/sec per GPU" or we avoid deterministic wording until p99 is stable.

emily: Agree — use ranges and specify test config.

alex: Thanks everyone — next steps: samira to post runbook PR, tim to confirm PDU + S3 creds, nimbus-biz to share marketing assets and NDA info. Will sync next Wed 09:30 PT if needed. :rocket:
